duration.text: The Computer Science and Technology at Changchun University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 5.Official high school or middle school transcript 6.Two letters of recommendation From teachers familiar with the applicant's scholastic aptitude and general character

requirements.text: 1.Foreign students should be at least 17 years old. 2.Be in good health condition
